text: But I'll be so lonely.” Her throat seemed young, above her loose blouse of muslin and machine-lace. “Tell you, Maud: I'll drop in just for a minute, if I happen to be called down that way.” “If you'd like,” demurely. “O Will, I just want comfort. I know you're all married, and my, such a proud papa, and of course now----If I could just sit near you in the dusk, and be quiet, and forget Dave! You WILL come?” “Sure I will!” “I'll expect you.
